name: notion-multipart-uploader
description: Production multipart uploader for the Notion API. Upload local files over 20 MiB without external hosting—automatic 10 MiB chunking, progress, retries, cancellation, and concurrent part uploads. Returns a Notion file_upload ID ready to attach to pages and blocks.

scripts.test:mcp: rm -f mcp-server/*.tgz && npm pack --pack-destination mcp-server && cd mcp-server && npm install --no-save --no-package-lock ./notion-multipart-uploader-*.tgz && npm test

author: Shoubhik Saha <officialshoubhiksaha@gmail.com>
